notes.title: Painted Lines
notes.content:
Added a quick update which added painted soccer lines on the field.

This also may remove your local personal best scores. If you want them back, please copy "settings.dat", "settings2.dat", and "settings3.dat from 

C:\Users\<Your Name>\AppData\LocalLow\RobFrank\GoalkeepVr

to

C:\Users\<Your Name>\AppData\LocalLow\DigitalBadger Design LLC\GoalkeepVr

notes.title: Big update!
notes.content:
Just updated the game which includes the following requested features:

- Player height adjustment slider
- Two new game modes (slow mo and silly)
- Ability to select a random game mode
- Semi-realistic glove hand model option instead of the "Marshmallows"

I hope everyone likes it and let me know if something goes wrong!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27367617/79210a5720aa300134f497e5c943ec56a59efb41.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Shrinking Balls Game Mode
notes.content:
Added shrinking balls game mode! Balls start huge and each one gets smaller and smaller. How long can you last?

View leaderboards on the community hub to see where you rank.

Also, should show up in the VR section on Steam now.
